messages.content: 我如何找到給定動量的力角度？

function.name: calculate_vector_angle
function.description: Calculate the angle of a vector based on its X and Y components. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

X_component.description: The X component of the vector. This is a float type value.

Y_component.description: The Y component of the vector. This is a float type value.

use_degrees.description: If true, the result will be in degrees. If false, the result will be in radians. Default is false.

Might be physics: Force is derivative of momentum: F = dp/dt. If momentum vector known, maybe they want angle of force relative to something? They might want to compute angle of a vector given its components. The tool calculate_vector_angle can compute angle of a vector given X and Y components. So we can use that. If momentum changes, force direction is direction of change. So angle between force and momentum? Use dot product. But maybe they just want to compute angle of a vector. So we can ask for components.
